# A program's top level is its windows. The package body is a slot for the
# root tree and a window is that tree's one renderable member, so what a file's
# root holds is windows -- and a `ui` node there is the ordinary tree error
# (testdata/error_toplevel_ui_node.sngl). `component main` is not a wrapper a
# program writes either way (#135, #208).
#
# passRootWindow lifts what the body holds onto pkg.Windows before any other
# pass runs. That is the whole implementation strategy: two dozen lowering
# passes and five platforms already walk pkg.Windows, and a second shape
# carrying a body is a second thing each of them has to know -- which is
# exactly where #133 came from.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=w-html win.sngl
sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=w-bt win.sngl
sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=w-fy win.sngl
sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=w-an win.sngl

# The state is the package's, and it has to reach the page as state rather than
# as a name nothing declared -- the failure mode #133 documented.
grep 'var state = \{ n: 0 \}' w-html/index.html
grep 'state.n = state.n \+ 1' w-html/index.html

# Several windows coexist: the first is the root the program opens at, the
# others are what it navigates to. The root takes index.html even though it is
# not the only window, which is what distinguishes "first" from "only".
sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=both both.sngl
exists both/index.html
exists both/about/index.html
grep 'visits' both/index.html
grep 'About this app' both/about/index.html

# A component instantiated with no block parses as a call statement, not a
# visual node -- `counter()` is an *ast.CallStmt -- and it is the shape a
# window usually has: composition at the top, behaviour in components (which is
# also what a test names, since a composition root has no instance to hand a
# test).
# The instance's state is renamed per instance by the inliner, which is what a
# component instantiated in a body has always done.
sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=comp compose.sngl
grep 'var state = \{ n__inst0: 0 \}' comp/index.html
grep 'state.n__inst0 = state.n__inst0 \+ 1' comp/index.html

-- win.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

var n = 0

window {
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
        button #inc(text="+", @click { n = n + 1 })
    }
}

-- both.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

var visits = 0

window #root(title="Home", href="/") {
    vbox {
        text(value="visits: {visits}")
        link(href="/about", text="About")
    }
}

window #about(title="About", href="/about") {
    vbox {
        text(value="About this app")
        link(href="/", text="Home")
    }
}

-- compose.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

window {
    counter()
}

component counter ui {
    var n = 0
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
        button #inc(text="+", @click { n = n + 1 })
    }
}
